prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet audio feedback test flow: Introduce an audio sound check step during pet customization to let users hear their pet sound style before adoption.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Listen to your pet sound preview before confirming selection."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_sound_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Grid layout sign-in screen redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a grid layout with visual cards for social and email authentication options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress"}}
2: [finish, redesign] Two-column finish screen layout: Redesign home_intro into a two-column layout highlighting desktop pet arrival on the left and immediate launch controls on the right.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!"}}
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop rendering diagnostic screen: Add a display verification screen right before waiting to test desktop rendering capabilities and permissions.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Initializing Desktop Pet Display"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_display_check", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [choose_path, copy] Story screen pet companion promise copy: Update story screen headline and body to emphasize account data protection and permanent pet saving.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your Permanent Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet stays saved safely to your account across all logins and device updates."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen background preparation tip: Display background rendering tips and step status messages while waiting for the pet to launch on desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Setting up graphics overlay... your pet will appear directly on your screen shortly.", "tip_delay_seconds": 5}}
6: [adoption, layout] Compact layout for adoption certificate: Switch adoption_certificate layout to compact view with prominent pet naming input and quick confirm action.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Name Your Pet Companion"}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop taskbar tray interaction hint: Add a direct hint on the home intro screen explaining how to summon or hide the pet using the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet or use the system tray icon anytime to adjust pet controls and visibility."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] List layout choose path redesign: Reformat choose_path screen to a list layout with concise path option descriptions.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Choose How You Want to Build Your Companion"}}
9: [sign_in, copy] Sign in account restoration emphasis copy: Update sign-in headline to explicitly mention account restoration for returning pet owners.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore or Save Your Pet", "body": "Logging in connects your desktop pet to your account so your companion is never lost."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds an audio preview step during onboarding without removing required steps or violating design guidelines.
Redesigns sign-in screen into a grid layout while preserving sign-in functionality.
Redesigns home_intro into a two-column layout within valid onboarding boundaries.
Adds a display check screen before waiting while keeping all required onboarding steps intact.
Updates story copy to emphasize account saving while continuing to introduce the pet.
Displays background preparation tips on the waiting screen without altering pricing or core step functionality.
Redesigns adoption certificate into a compact layout while retaining its adoption function.
Adds tray interaction hint on home_intro overlay, which is part of onboarding.
Re-formats choose_path to a list layout without losing path selection choices.
Updates sign-in copy to emphasize account restoration within onboarding limits.
